name: Bekee maka Ndụ Kwa Ụbọchị (ESL)
objectives: Mgbe ị zutere onye ọhụrụ, ịkọwa onwe gị na Bekee site n'ikwu aha gị, ebe i si na ihe ị na-arụ, ma jụghachi otu ajụjụ, n'opekata mpe ahịrịokwu atọ dị mkpụmkpụ
Mgbe ị ghọtaghị ihe mmadụ kwuru, ịrịọ onye ahụ ka o kwughachi, kwuo nwayọọ ma ọ bụ sụpe okwu site n'okwu Bekee nwere nkwanye ugwu, kama ime ka à ga-asị na ị ghọtara
N'ụlọ ahịa, ịjụ ebe ihe dị, jụọ ọnụ ahịa ya ma kwuo otu ị ga-esi kwụọ ụgwọ, site n'iji okwu sitere na nkuzi ahụ

chapters.name: Isi 1: Izute ndị mmadụ na ịzụ ahịa

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Ikele mmadụ na ịkọwa onwe gị
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Kọwaa onwe gị n'ahịrịokwu atọ dị mkpụmkpụ ma jụghachi otu ajụjụ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe ị zutere onye ọhụrụ, ị ga-enwe ike ịkọwa onwe gị na Bekee site n'ikwu aha gị, ebe i si na ihe ị na-arụ, ma jụghachi otu ajụjụ, n'opekata mpe ahịrịokwu atọ dị mkpụmkpụ.
Mgbe ị zutere onye ọhụrụ, malite n'ekele: "Hello." ma ọ bụ "Hi." N'ụtụtụ ị nwere ike ikwu "Good morning." Wee kwuo aha gị: "My name is Ana." ma ọ bụ "I'm Ana."
Tinye ebe i si na ihe ị na-arụ: "I'm from Guatemala." "I work at a restaurant." "I'm looking for a job." Wee jụghachi ajụjụ: "What's your name?" "Where are you from?" Mgbe ha zara, kwuo "Nice to meet you."
Mkparịta ụka ọmụmaatụ. A: "Hi, I'm Ana. What's your name?" B: "I'm Sam. Nice to meet you." A: "Nice to meet you too. I'm from Guatemala. I work at a restaurant." B: "Oh, which one?"
Ọ dịghị mkpa ka i kwuo ahịrịokwu ogologo. Ahịrịokwu atọ dị mkpụmkpụ ma doo anya bụ ezigbo mkpọlite onwe gị. Mụmụọ ọnụ ọchị, lee onye ahụ anya ma kwuo okwu nwayọọ nwayọọ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Kelee: "Hello." ma ọ bụ "Good morning."
- Kwuo aha gị: "My name is ..." ma ọ bụ "I'm ..."
- Kwuo ebe i si: "I'm from ..."
- Kwuo ihe ị na-arụ: "I work at ..." ma ọ bụ "I'm looking for a job."
- Jụghachi otu ajụjụ: "What's your name?" Wee kwuo "Nice to meet you."
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- "I'm": ụzọ dị mkpụmkpụ isi kwuo "I am" (abụ m).
- "Nice to meet you": okwu nkwanye ugwu ị na-ekwu mgbe ị zutere mmadụ na nke mbụ.
- Ịkọwa onwe gị: ịgwa onye ọhụrụ onye ị bụ.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- USA Learns: ihe ọmụmụ Bekee n'efu maka ndị okenye (Sacramento County Office of Education)
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee mkpọlite onwe gị: aha gị, ebe i si na ihe ị na-arụ, n'ahịrịokwu atọ dị mkpụmkpụ. Tinye otu ajụjụ ị ga-ajụghachi. Gụpụta ya n'olu dị elu ugboro atọ. Wee kwuo ya n'eleghị akwụkwọ ahụ anya.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkọwa onwe gị n'ahịrịokwu Bekee atọ dị mkpụmkpụ ma jụghachi onye ọhụrụ ajụjụ.

check.q: Mmadụ kwuru "Nice to meet you." Gịnị bụ ezigbo azịza?
check.why: "Nice to meet you too" bụ azịza nkwanye ugwu mgbe ị zutere mmadụ.

check.q: Kedu mkpọlite onwe gị nwere aha, ebe i si na ihe ị na-arụ?
options: "I'm Ali. I'm from Somalia. I drive a truck."
check.why: Ọ na-enye aha, obodo na ọrụ n'ahịrịokwu atọ dị mkpụmkpụ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: Ịrịọ mmadụ ka o kwughachi, kwuo nwayọọ ma ọ bụ sụpe okwu
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Rịọ mmadụ ka o kwughachi, kwuo nwayọọ ma ọ bụ sụpe okwu site n'okwu nwere nkwanye ugwu.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe ị ghọtaghị ihe mmadụ kwuru, ị ga-enwe ike ịrịọ onye ahụ ka o kwughachi, kwuo nwayọọ ma ọ bụ sụpe okwu site n'okwu Bekee nwere nkwanye ugwu, kama ime ka à ga-asị na ị ghọtara.
Onye ọ bụla na-atụfu okwu mgbe ụfọdụ, ọbụlagodi ndị Bekee bụ asụsụ mbụ ha. Ịjụ ajụjụ bụ ihe nkịtị ma nwee nkwanye ugwu. Ọ ka mma nke ukwuu karịa ikwu "yes" mgbe ị ghọtaghị.
Okwu bara uru: "Sorry, can you repeat that, please?" "Can you speak more slowly, please?" "How do you spell that?" "What does that word mean?" "Can you write it down, please?"
Iji lelee na ị ghọtara, kwughachi ya: "So, Tuesday at 3 o'clock?" Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ naanị otu akụkụ ka ị tụfuru, jụọ maka akụkụ ahụ: "Sorry, what time?"
Mkparịta ụka ọmụmaatụ. A: "Your pickup is at the side entrance at four fifteen." B: "Sorry, can you speak more slowly, please?" A: "Side entrance. Four fifteen." B: "So, the side door at 4:15?" A: "Yes, that's right."
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Emela ka à ga-asị na ị ghọtara.
- Kwuo "Sorry," ma rịọ: ka o kwughachi, kwuo nwayọọ, sụpe ma ọ bụ dee ya.
- Kwughachi akụkụ dị mkpa iji lelee ya.
- Chere ka ọ sị "Yes, that's right."
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- "Repeat": ikwughachi ya ọzọ.
- "Slowly": nwayọọ, ọ bụghị ngwa ngwa.
- "Spell": ikwu mkpụrụedemede okwu otu otu.
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee okwu anọ ahụ e ji arịọ enyemaka n'obere kaadị, debe ya n'akpa gị ma ọ bụ n'ekwentị gị. Gụpụta nke ọ bụla n'olu dị elu ugboro ise. Wee gbanye redio ma ọ bụ vidiyo a na-ekwu okwu Bekee, ma oge ọ bụla ị tụfuru ihe, kwuo otu n'ime okwu ndị ahụ n'olu dị elu.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịrịọ mmadụ ka o kwughachi, kwuo nwayọọ, sụpe ma ọ bụ dee okwu, ma kwughachi ihe ị nụrụ iji lelee ya.

check.q: Onye ọrụ na-ekwu okwu ngwa ngwa nke ukwuu, ị tụfuo ya. Gịnị ka ị ga-ekwu?
check.why: Ịrịọ onye ahụ ka o kwuo nwayọọ nwere nkwanye ugwu ma na-enyere gị aka inweta ozi ahụ.

check.q: Nọọsụ kwuru aha dọkịta gị, ma ị pụghị ide ya. Gịnị ka ị ga-ajụ?
check.why: "How do you spell that?" na-arịọ mkpụrụedemede ka i wee dee aha ahụ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Ịzụ ahịa: ịchọta ihe, ọnụ ahịa na ịkwụ ụgwọ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Jụọ ebe ihe dị, jụọ ọnụ ahịa ya ma kwuo otu ị ga-esi kwụọ ụgwọ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: N'ụlọ ahịa, ị ga-enwe ike ịjụ ebe ihe dị, jụọ ọnụ ahịa ya ma kwuo otu ị ga-esi kwụọ ụgwọ, site n'iji okwu sitere na nkuzi ahụ.
Iji chọta ihe, kwuo "Excuse me" ma jụọ: "Where can I find the rice?" ma ọ bụ "Do you have diapers?" Onye ọrụ nwere ike ịsị "Aisle 5" (ahịrị nwere nọmba n'ime ụlọ ahịa) ma ọ bụ "Sorry, we're out of it."
Iji jụọ ọnụ ahịa: "How much is this?" ma ọ bụ "How much are these?" maka ihe karịrị otu. N'ebe a na-akwụ ụgwọ, onye na-anara ego nwere ike ịjụ: "Cash or card?" "Do you want a bag?" "Do you want your receipt?" Zaa: "Card, please." "No bag, thanks." "Yes, please."
Debe akwụkwọ ịnata ego (receipt) gị. Iji weghachi ihe, kwuo: "I'd like to return this, please. Here is my receipt." Ụlọ ahịa ọ bụla nwere iwu nke ya maka ịweghachi ihe, ya mere ị nwere ike ịjụ: "What is your return policy?"
Mkparịta ụka ọmụmaatụ. A: "Excuse me, where can I find the milk?" B: "In the back, next to the eggs." A: "Thanks. How much is this?" B: "Three ninety-nine." A: "Okay. Card, please."
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Kwuo "Excuse me" iji nweta enyemaka.
- Jụọ "Where can I find ...?"
- Jụọ "How much is this?"
- N'ebe a na-akwụ ụgwọ, zaa "Cash or card?" na "Do you want a bag?"
- Debe receipt maka ịweghachi ihe.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- "Aisle": ahịrị n'ime ụlọ ahịa nwere shelf n'akụkụ abụọ. Ọ na-ada ka "I'll".
- "Receipt": akwụkwọ na-egosi ihe ị zụtara na ego i kwụrụ. A naghị akpọ p ya.
- "Return": iweghachi ihe n'ụlọ ahịa ka e nyeghachi gị ego gị.
- "Cashier": onye ọrụ na-anara gị ego n'ebe a na-akwụ ụgwọ.
Nwaa ugbu a: Mee ya dị ka egwuregwu gị na onye ọzọ, ma ọ bụ kwuo akụkụ abụọ n'olu dị elu: ị nọ n'ụlọ ahịa nri. Jụọ ebe ihe abụọ dị, jụọ ọnụ ahịa otu n'ime ha, ma zaa ajụjụ atọ nke cashier. Oge ọzọ ị gara ahịa, jiri otu okwu n'ezie.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịjụ ebe ihe dị n'ụlọ ahịa, jụọ ọnụ ahịa, zaa cashier ma rịọ ka i weghachi ihe.

check.q: Ị chọrọ ịma ọnụ ahịa uwe elu abụọ. Gịnị ka ị ga-ajụ?
check.why: "How much are these?" na-ajụ ọnụ ahịa ihe karịrị otu.

check.q: Cashier jụrụ "Cash or card?" Gịnị ka ọ chọrọ ịma?
check.why: "Cash or card?" na-ajụ otu ị ga-esi kwụọ ụgwọ.

chapters.name: Isi 2: Dọkịta, ekwentị na ịga ebe dị iche iche

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: N'ebe dọkịta: ikwu ihe na-eme gị
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Gwa dọkịta ma ọ bụ nọọsụ ihe na-eme gị, ebe na-afụ gị ụfụ na ogologo oge ọ dịla.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: N'ụlọ ọrụ dọkịta ma ọ bụ n'ekwentị, ị ga-enwe ike ikwu ihe na-eme gị ma hazie oge ịhụ dọkịta n'ụbọchị na oge dabara gị, na-ekwu aha gị, nsogbu ahụ na oge ahụ, ma na-ekwughachi oge ahụ.
N'ebe a na-anabata ndị mmadụ (front desk), kwuo: "Hi, I have an appointment at 10 o'clock. My name is Ana Lopez." Ha nwere ike ịrịọ ụbọchị ọmụmụ gị na kaadị insurance gị.
Iji kwuo ihe na-eme gị: "I have a headache." "I have a fever." "My stomach hurts." "My back hurts." "I feel dizzy." Wee kwuo ogologo oge ọ dịla: "It started two days ago." ma ọ bụ "I've had it since Monday." Dọkịta nwere ike ịjụ: "Does it hurt here?" Zaa: "Yes, there." ma ọ bụ "No."
Ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ enyemaka na Bekee, ị nwere ike ịjụ: "Do you have an interpreter?" Interpreter bụ onye na-enyere gị aka ịgwa dọkịta okwu n'asụsụ gị. Rịọ dọkịta ka o dee ntụziaka: "Can you write that down, please?" Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akụzi naanị okwu. Ajụjụ gbasara ahụike gị na-aga n'aka dọkịta ma ọ bụ nọọsụ gị.
Na mberede, dị ka nsogbu iku ume ma ọ bụ mgbu obi, kpọọ 911 ma kwuo: "I need an ambulance." Wee kwuo ebe ị nọ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- N'ebe nnabata: kwuo oge e nyere gị na aha gị.
- Kwuo ihe na-eme gị: "I have a ..." ma ọ bụ "My ... hurts."
- Kwuo ogologo oge: "for two days" ma ọ bụ "since Monday".
- Rịọ interpreter ma ọ bụ ntụziaka e dere ede ma ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ ha.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- "Appointment": ụbọchị na oge a kara aka ịhụ mmadụ, dị ka dọkịta.
- "Fever": mgbe ahụ gị na-ekpo ọkụ nke ukwuu n'ihi na ị na-arịa ọrịa.
- "Interpreter": onye na-enyere mmadụ abụọ na-asụ asụsụ dị iche aka ịkparịta ụka.
- "Insurance card": kaadị sitere na atụmatụ ahụike gị nke ọfịs ahụ na-arịọ ịhụ.
Nwaa ugbu a: Naanị omume, na nsogbu e chepụtara echepụta: dee ahịrịokwu atọ maka dọkịta, dịka ọmụmaatụ "I have a sore throat. It started on Sunday. It hurts when I swallow." Gụpụta ha n'olu dị elu. Wee mee omume ihe ị ga-ekwu n'ebe nnabata na aha na oge e chepụtara echepụta.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịbanye n'ebe nnabata, kwuo ihe na-eme gị na ogologo oge ọ dịla, ma rịọ interpreter ma ọ bụ ntụziaka e dere ede.

check.q: Isi na-afụ gị ụfụ kemgbe ụnyaahụ. Gịnị ka ị ga-agwa dọkịta?
check.why: Ọ na-ekwu nsogbu ahụ na ogologo oge ọ dịla.

check.q: Ị naghị aghọta dọkịta nke ọma. Gịnị ka ị nwere ike ịjụ?
check.why: Interpreter na-enyere gị na dọkịta aka ịghọta onwe unu.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Oku ekwentị: ịhazi oge ịhụ dọkịta na ịkpọ ụlọ akwụkwọ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Hazie oge ịhụ dọkịta n'ekwentị ma kwughachi ụbọchị na oge ahụ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: N'ụlọ ọrụ dọkịta ma ọ bụ n'ekwentị, ị ga-enwe ike ikwu ihe na-eme gị ma hazie oge ịhụ dọkịta n'ụbọchị na oge dabara gị, na-ekwu aha gị, nsogbu ahụ na oge ahụ, ma na-ekwughachi oge ahụ. Mgbe ị ghọtaghị ihe mmadụ kwuru, ị ga-enwe ike ịrịọ onye ahụ ka o kwughachi, kwuo nwayọọ ma ọ bụ sụpe okwu site n'okwu Bekee nwere nkwanye ugwu, kama ime ka à ga-asị na ị ghọtara.
Oku ekwentị siri ike n'ihi na ị naghị ahụ onye ahụ. Kwadebe okwu gị tupu ị kpọọ, ma dobe mkpịsị ode na akwụkwọ n'aka.
Iji hazie oge: "Hi, my name is Ana Lopez. I'd like to make an appointment, please." Ha ga-ajụ: "What is it for?" "What day works for you?" Zaa: "I have a cough." "Tuesday morning is good." Wee kwughachi ya: "So, Tuesday the 12th at 9:30?" Iji gbanwee ya: "I need to change my appointment, please."
Iji kpọọ ụlọ akwụkwọ nwa gị mgbe nwa gị na-arịa ọrịa: "Hi, this is Ana Lopez. My son, David Lopez, is sick today. He is in second grade. He will not come to school today."
Ọ bụrụ na oku ahụ na-aga ngwa ngwa nke ukwuu, jiri okwu gị sitere na Nkuzi 2: "Sorry, can you speak more slowly, please?" "Can you spell that?" Ọ bụrụ na ha kwuru nọmba ekwentị, kwughachi ya n'otu n'otu: "5-5-5, 0-1-2-3?"
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Dee ihe ị ga-ekwu tupu ị kpọọ.
- Kwuo aha gị na ihe mere ị ji akpọ.
- Zaa: ihe ọ bụ maka ya, na ụbọchị na oge dabara gị.
- Dee ụbọchị na oge ahụ, wee kwughachi ya.
- Mechie: "Thank you. Bye."
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- "Make an appointment": ịhazi ụbọchị na oge ịhụ mmadụ.
- "Change" / "cancel": ibufe ya n'oge ọzọ / ịkagbu oge ahụ.
- "What works for you?": ajụjụ pụtara "kedu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ oge dabara gị?"
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee obere ihe ị ga-ekwu n'ekwentị iji hazie oge ịhụ dọkịta, na aha na nsogbu e chepụtara echepụta. Mee ya dị ka egwuregwu gị na onye ọzọ, ma ọ bụ kwuo akụkụ abụọ n'olu dị elu. Hụ na i kwughachiri ụbọchị na oge ahụ na njedebe.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịhazi ma ọ bụ gbanwee oge ịhụ dọkịta n'ekwentị, kpọọ ụlọ akwụkwọ nwa gị, ma kwughachi ụbọchị na oge iji lelee ya.

check.q: Ọfịs ahụ kwuru "What day works for you?" Gịnị ka ha chọrọ?
check.why: "What day works for you?" na-ajụ ụbọchị dabara gị.

check.q: Ọfịs ahụ kwuru oge e nyere gị. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme ọzọ?
options: Kwughachi ụbọchị na oge ahụ iji lelee ya
check.why: Ịkwughachi ụbọchị na oge ahụ na-eme ka ị jide n'aka na ị nụrụ ya nke ọma.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Ịjụ ụzọ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Jụọ ụzọ ebe ị na-aga ma kwughachi ya iji lelee ya.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ebe ị chọrọ ịga, ị ga-enwe ike ịjụ ụzọ ma kwughachi ụzọ ahụ iji lelee ya, na-eji okwu ụzọ dị ka left, right, straight na next to.
Malite na "Excuse me." Wee jụọ: "How do I get to the library?" ma ọ bụ "Where is the bus stop?" ma ọ bụ "Is the post office near here?"
Okwu ụzọ: "Go straight." "Turn left." "Turn right." "It's on the corner." "It's next to the bank." "It's across from the park." "Go two blocks." Block bụ akụkụ okporo ụzọ dị n'etiti nkuku abụọ.
Kwughachi ụzọ ahụ: "So, go straight two blocks, then turn left?" Onye ahụ ga-asị "Yes" ma ọ bụ dozie ya. Ọ bụrụ na ọ karịrị gị, jụọ: "Can you show me on my phone?" ma ọ bụ "Can you point?"
Mkparịta ụka ọmụmaatụ. A: "Excuse me, how do I get to the clinic?" B: "Go straight two blocks and turn right. It's next to the pharmacy." A: "So, straight two blocks, turn right, next to the pharmacy?" B: "That's right." A: "Thank you!"
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Kwuo "Excuse me."
- Jụọ "How do I get to ...?" ma ọ bụ "Where is ...?"
- Gee ntị maka left, right, straight, blocks na next to.
- Kwughachi ụzọ ahụ.
- Kwuo "Thank you!"
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- "Straight": n'ihu, n'atụgharịghị.
- "Block": akụkụ okporo ụzọ dị n'etiti nkuku abụọ.
- "Across from": n'ofe okporo ụzọ, chere ihe ahụ ihu.
- "Next to": n'akụkụ ihe ahụ kpọmkwem.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- USA Learns: omume Bekee n'efu maka ndị okenye
Nwaa ugbu a: Ọrụ ikpeazụ: mee kaadị okwu Bekee kwa ụbọchị gị. Dee mkpọlite onwe gị, okwu atọ iji rịọ mmadụ ka o kwughachi ma ọ bụ kwuo nwayọọ, ajụjụ abụọ maka ụlọ ahịa, obere ihe ị ga-ekwu n'ekwentị maka oge ịhụ dọkịta, na otu ajụjụ iji jụọ ụzọ ebe ị na-agakarị. Gụpụta kaadị ahụ niile n'olu dị elu, ma ọ bụ mee ya dị ka egwuregwu gị na onye ọzọ, ma dekọọ olu gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ike.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịjụ ụzọ, ghọta left, right, straight na next to, ma kwughachi ụzọ ahụ iji lelee ya.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị Ịkọwa onwe gị Ihe na-erughị ahịrịokwu atọ, ma ọ bụ enweghị aha ma ọ bụ ajụjụ a jụghachiri. Na-ekwu aha, ebe o si na ihe ọ na-arụ, ma jụghachi otu ajụjụ. Na-ekwu ya n'olu dị elu n'agụghị ya, ma tinyekwa ihe ọzọ, dị ka ebumnuche. Ịrịọ ka o kwughachi ma ọ bụ kwuo nwayọọ Enweghị okwu, ma ọ bụ okwu ahụ enweghị nkwanye ugwu. Okwu atọ nwere nkwanye ugwu iji kwughachi, kwuo nwayọọ, sụpe ma ọ bụ dee ya. Na-egosikwa otu e si akwughachi ihe iji lelee ya, dị ka "So, Tuesday at 3?" Ajụjụ ụlọ ahịa Enweghị ajụjụ ụlọ ahịa, ma ọ bụ ha anaghị ajụ maka ihe ma ọ bụ ọnụ ahịa. Ajụjụ abụọ doro anya, dị ka ebe ihe dị na ọnụ ahịa ya. Na-azakwa ajụjụ cashier n'egwuregwu omume. Ihe a ga-ekwu n'ekwentị maka oge ịhụ dọkịta Aha, ihe kpatara ya ma ọ bụ ụbọchị na oge adịghị. Na-enye aha, ihe kpatara ya, ụbọchị na oge dabara, ma kwughachi oge ahụ. Na-egosikwa otu e si agbanwe oge ahụ ma ọ bụ arịọ interpreter. Ịjụ ụzọ Enweghị ajụjụ, ma ọ bụ ajụjụ ahụ akpọghị aha ebe. Ajụjụ doro anya maka ezi ebe, na ahịrịokwu na-akwughachi ụzọ ahụ. Na-eji okwu ụzọ atọ nke ọma n'egwuregwu omume. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, mee omume akụkụ ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.
